arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'PYEOF' > tests/match.json
import json, struct, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project/src'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from eywa.offline import Campaign
from fuzz_value import ktest
def enc(v, w): return v.to_bytes(w, 'little')
NS = 512
PAT = "[a-cx-z]*ab[a-c]*xy[0-9][a-c]*xy[0-9][a-c]*xy[0-9][a-c]*ab[a-cx-z]*"
types = [{"name": "S", "kind": "string", "maxsize": NS},
         {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
         {"name": "V", "kind": "array", "element": "B", "size": 8}]
campaign = {
  "types": types,
  "modules": [{"name": "m", "params": [["s", "S"], ["v", "V"]],
               "result": ["o", "B"],
               "requires": ["and", ["match", ["var", "s"], PAT],
                            ["all", "x", ["var", "v"], ["eq", ["var", "x"], ["const", "B", True]]]]}],
  "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
camp = Campaign(campaign); camp.certificate()
plan = camp.plans[0]
by_path = {tuple(p): t for t, p, w in plan.slots}
result_tag = [t for t, p, w in plan.slots if p == ['o']][0]
runs = []
text = 'a' * NS
for _ in range(120):
    objs = [(by_path[('s', i)], enc(ord(text[i]), 1)) for i in range(NS)]
    objs += [(by_path[('v', i)], enc(1, 1)) for i in range(8)]
    objs.append((result_tag, enc(1, 1)))
    runs.append({"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest(objs)})
campaign['runs'] = runs
sys.stderr.write('pattern %d chars, string %d, match units %d\n' % (len(PAT), NS, 120 * len(PAT) * (NS + 1)))
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(campaign))
PYEOF
time python3 /workspace/project/campaign_cli.py < tests/match.json | python3 -c "

print(Counter(r['status'] for r in d['records']))"
